findings.rule: REVIEW.md framework rule: "The second occurrence of the same finding across reviews produces a one-line entry in CLAUDE.md under 'Things Claude gets wrong', proposed in the review for the owner." Proposed line: "Duplicating a lazy `from <pkg> import <mod>` in two functions of the same file instead of importing once at the top of the module or in one shared helper: hoist it."
findings.summary: `from lessons import index as lessons_mod` is still duplicated in `_supersedes_problem` (line 1616) and `lesson_and_eval` (line 1644) instead of imported once; `changes/.review-seen.json` already records this exact finding at count 2 (first seen during this change's gate-(e) round, repeated unaddressed in the b94e362 review), so this third occurrence is the point the framework rule requires a one-line `CLAUDE.md` entry, which no review has proposed yet.

findings.rule: REVIEW.md framework rule: "The second occurrence of the same finding across reviews produces a one-line entry in CLAUDE.md..." Proposed line: "Interpolating a free-text field into a generated markdown link (`[text](file)`) without escaping `]`/`(`/`)` in the text: escape or reject those characters before writing."
findings.summary: `_render_line`/`_render_unsorted_line` (lines 231-242) still interpolate `title`/`description`/the first heading into a markdown link with no escaping of `]`/`(`, so such a value would still break the generated link; `changes/.review-seen.json` records this exact finding at count 2 already, so this is the third occurrence with no `CLAUDE.md` line proposed.

findings.rule: REVIEW.md framework rule: "The second occurrence of the same finding across reviews produces a one-line entry in CLAUDE.md..." Proposed line: "A function named `check`/read-only must never call a `build`/write helper that has a filesystem side effect (e.g. `mkdir`) — split the side effect out so a dry-run check never touches disk."
findings.summary: `build()` still unconditionally runs `lessons_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`, so the read-only `check()` (and `lesson_and_eval`'s call into it) still creates `lessons/` as a side effect on a project that has none yet; `changes/.review-seen.json` records this exact finding at count 2 already, so this is the third occurrence with no `CLAUDE.md` line proposed (the owner's own fix-response marked it optional for 0.3.7, but the recurrence rule is about repetition, not about whether a fix was required).

findings.rule: REVIEW.md framework rule: "The second occurrence of the same finding across reviews produces a one-line entry in CLAUDE.md..." Proposed line: "A template/README example for a field that can take N shapes (e.g. lessons/README.md's `sources`) must show all N in the worked example, not a subset."
findings.summary: The example frontmatter's `sources` list (lines 45-51) still shows only `detection`, `eval` and `fix-pr`, with no sample `run-<n>` entry, even though spec.md's Requirements say `sources` includes "one `run-<n>` per failed run `detection.json` lists"; `changes/.review-seen.json` already records this exact finding at count 2, so this is the third occurrence with still no `CLAUDE.md` line proposed.
